summary: To change certificates with the RPM installer, use PEM files (server cert first, then intermediate) and set automationedacontroller_ssl_cert/key, automationgateway_ssl_cert/key, automationhub_ssl_cert/key, web_server_ssl_cert/key and custom_ca_cert (the root CA, installed in /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors).
questions: Which inventory variables set custom SSL certificates on RPM AAP?
In what order do I put the intermediate certificate?

answer_card.title: Custom certs with the RPM installer
answer_card.answer_md:
PEM files; server cert first, then the intermediate CA appended.
- EDA: `automationedacontroller_ssl_cert`, `automationedacontroller_ssl_key`
- Gateway: `automationgateway_ssl_cert`, `automationgateway_ssl_key`
- Hub: `automationhub_ssl_cert`, `automationhub_ssl_key`
- Controller: `web_server_ssl_cert`, `web_server_ssl_key`
- All: `custom_ca_cert` = root CA that signed the intermediate

Run the installer.
